## Checklist

- [ ] The title is a conventional commit with a short subject, e.g. `fix(sync): …`
- [ ] `./gradlew assembleDebug lintDebug` passes
- [ ] `scripts/test.sh` passes on a phone and a tablet (or explain what you could not run)
- [ ] A screenshot is attached if this changes what the user sees
- [ ] No real user data in fixtures, screenshots or logs
- [ ] Docs and comments updated where behaviour changed
